content: coffee A controlled blast on a movie set near London’s O2 arena ignited a fire that wrecked a van and damaged a car and a lorry. Firefighters were summoned to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before eight on Saturday evening. After about an hour, with twenty‑five crews on scene, the flames were brought under control and no injuries were reported. The incident is said to have stemmed from a pre‑arranged filming activity at the venue, which also stages upcoming shows by Niall Horan and Texas. The London Fire Brigade posted on X that the fire in the Silvertown yard is now under control, noting that one vehicle was destroyed and most of a car and lorry suffered damage, with no injury reports. They added that the fire originated from a controlled explosion on the set that got out of hand, that crews acted swiftly to put it out, and that personnel would stay until the evening ended. The yard is close to the Thames cable car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
